newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Asian dollar deposits market was closed on Friday for a holiday. It will reopen on Monday, March 31.

On Thursday, Thursday/Friday rose 3/16 percentage point to 6-5/16 6-3/16 percent and weekend rose 1/16 point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent. Week-fixed was unchanged from Wednesday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8, six-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
